bio: Sarah Smith was a daughter of Caleb Smith 2d and so a descendant of Bull Smith in the fifth generation, through Daniel, Daniel 2d and Caleb; that descent makes her John's 4th cousin 7 times removed. She married Major Ebenezer Smith (1795-1879). Their sons were Ethelbert M. and Caleb T. Smith.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 477 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
researchNotes: Wife of Major Ebenezer Smith (1795-1879); daughter of Caleb Smith 2d (Pelletreau, [R4-S1]), so herself a Bull Smith descendant: Bull -> Daniel -> Daniel 2d -> Caleb -> Caleb 2d -> Sarah (5 generations; 4C7R). Their sons were Ethelbert M. and Caleb T. Smith.
summary: Daughter of Caleb Smith 2d and wife of Major Ebenezer Smith; a Bull Smith descendant and John's 4th cousin 7 times removed.
